narr: Thunderstorms with heavy rain resulted in an isolated instance of flash flooding in Okaloosa County.
ev: Flooding reported at the intersection of Brookmeade Dr and Goodwin Ave, as well as Highway 85 and Main St.
lsr: STREETLIGHT AT HWY 85 & MAIN ST WAS STRUCK BY LIGHTNING CALL CAME IN AROUND 250PM. DISPATCH WAS SENT OUT AND ARRIVED ~320PM AND WATER WAS REPORTED COVERING THE ROADWAY AT THIS TIME.
WATER REPORTED COVERING ROADWAY AT THE INTERSECTION OF BROOKMEADE DR AND GOODWIN AVE.
